key_insight: The paper gives DEMs a formal algebraic semantics and a unique normal form, making detector error model equivalence decidable and efficiently computable.
engineering_relevance: This enables quantum compiler and QEC pipeline verification/optimization with rigorous correctness guarantees, including exact equivalence for non-adaptive workflows.
method: Defines DEMs as a symmetric monoidal theory over the Giry monad.
Develops a sound, terminating, confluent rewrite system with unique normal forms.
Uses Tanner graphs as complete structural invariants and computes them in quasilinear time.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a quasilinear-time algorithm O(k|E| log|E|) and states exact completeness for non-adaptive QEC, with sound applicability to partially adaptive circuits.
watch_item: The decision procedure is exact only for non-adaptive QEC; partially adaptive settings remain sound but not fully complete and may still require careful integration into compiler workflows.
paper_title: Quasilinear Equivalence Checking for Detector Error Models
